    level="1"

>
[Through the Gate](/Feats.aspx?ID=4335) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 57

**Archetype** [Kineticist](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=206)

**Prerequisites**
[Kineticist Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4333)

</column>

---

You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level [kineticist feat](/Feats.aspx?Traits=504) of your choice. Your options include [impulse](/Traits.aspx?ID=502) feats for your kinetic element, as normal for a kineticist.

<title level="2">Through the Gate leads to...</title>
[Advanced Element Control](/Feats.aspx?ID=4336)
